drivingQuestion: From where in the passage does the priest write the scroll, and what does he omit?

segments.he: מַתְנִי׳ בָּא לוֹ לִכְתּוֹב אֶת הַמְּגִילָּה, מֵאֵיזֶה מָקוֹם הוּא כּוֹתֵב?
segments.en: «MISHNA:» «When» the priest «comes to write the scroll» of the sota that is to be placed in the water, «from what place» in the Torah passage concerning the sota (Numbers 5:11–31) «does he write?»

segments.he: מִ״וְאִם לֹא שָׁכַב אִישׁ וְגוֹ׳ וְאַתְּ כִּי שָׂטִית תַּחַת אִישֵׁךְ״,
segments.en: He starts «from» the verse: «“If no man has lain» with you, and if you have not gone astray to defilement while under your husband, you shall be free from this water of bitterness that causes the curse” (Numbers 5:19); and continues: «“But if you have gone astray while under your husband,» and if you are defiled, and some man has lain with you besides your husband” (Numbers 5:20).

segments.he: וְאֵינוֹ כּוֹתֵב ״וְהִשְׁבִּיעַ הַכֹּהֵן אֶת הָאִשָּׁה״. וְכוֹתֵב: ״יִתֵּן ה׳ אוֹתָךְ לְאָלָה וְלִשְׁבֻעָה. וּבָאוּ הַמַּיִם הַמְאָרְרִים הָאֵלֶּה בְּמֵעַיִךְ לַצְבּוֹת בֶּטֶן וְלַנְפִּל יָרֵךְ״. וְאֵינוֹ כּוֹתֵב ״וְאָמְרָה הָאִשָּׁה אָמֵן אָמֵן״.
segments.en: «And» then «he does not write» the beginning of the following verse, which states: «“Then the priest shall cause the woman to swear» with the oath of cursing, and the priest shall say to the woman” (Numbers 5:21), «but he does write» the oath recorded in the continuation of the verse: «“The Lord shall make you a curse and an oath» among your people when the Lord will cause your thigh to fall away, and your belly to swell. «And this water that causes the curse shall go into your bowels, and cause your belly to swell, and your thigh to fall away”» (Numbers 5:21–22); «but he does not write» the conclusion of the verse: «“And the woman shall say: Amen, amen”» (Numbers 5:22).

segments.he: רַבִּי יוֹסֵי אוֹמֵר: לֹא הָיָה מַפְסִיק.
segments.en: «Rabbi Yosei says: He does not interrupt» the verses but rather writes the entire passage without any omissions.

segments.he: רַבִּי יְהוּדָה אוֹמֵר: כׇּל עַצְמוֹ אֵינוֹ כּוֹתֵב אֶלָּא ״יִתֵּן ה׳ אוֹתָךְ לְאָלָה וְלִשְׁבֻעָה וְגוֹ׳ וּבָאוּ הַמַּיִם הַמְאָרְרִים הָאֵלֶּה בְּמֵעַיִךְ וְגוֹ׳״. וְאֵינוֹ כּוֹתֵב ״וְאָמְרָה הָאִשָּׁה אָמֵן אָמֵן״.
segments.en: «Rabbi Yehuda says: He writes nothing other» than curses recorded in the final verses cited above: «“The Lord shall make you a curse and an oath» among your people when the Lord will cause your thigh to fall away, and your belly to swell. «And this water that causes the curse shall go into your bowels,» and cause your belly to swell, and your thigh to fall away.” «And he does not write» the conclusion of the verse: «“And the woman shall say: Amen, amen.”»
